{{Top}}
The '''Republic Survey Corps''' was a branch of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] whose duty was the exploration of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it was replaced by the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]]. Due to the differences between the Republic and the Empire, many alien scouts, such as [[Yurdak Fav]], resigned from their jobs.
